passage: Starting next month, employees may expense up to $500 annually for courses, books, or professional memberships without manager preapproval. Conference travel still requires approval. The change replaces the current $200 allowance and applies to all full-time employees after 90 days. Receipts must be submitted within 30 days through the usual expense system.

keyPoints.text: The annual learning allowance rises from $200 to $500 next month.
Eligible employees can use it without manager preapproval, except for conference travel.
It applies to full-time employees after 90 days, with receipts due within 30 days.

referenceAnswer: The annual learning allowance rises to $500 next month for eligible full-time employees, with no preapproval except for conferences.
